reviews_raw.author: Dale Kubala
reviews_raw.text:
How I stumbled on to AGM had to be Devine intervention. After speaking to several contractors, I was frustrated & coming from Brooklyn, I have major trust issues. I was on my way to Home Depot to get yet another quote and there in front of me was an AGM van. As I'm reading their services, I notice the Christian fish emblem. I'm thinking "How bad could they beat me up" Let me go see their show room. As soon as I walked in , I had a Great Vibe. Friendly, Real people and a nice showroom. I later found out it's a family business. Armando, the owner, came to my home with great ideas and never once tried to over sell. Fast forward, his team, starting from the ladies in the office to his incredible craftsmen delivered above and beyond. They showed up on time and delivered one hundred percent. I'm just sorry AGM didn't do my bathrooms. I am very happy and definitely glad I chose them.

John Agosta

reviews_raw.author: Tom Curtin
reviews_raw.text:
We were in a tough spot with an undetected washing machine plumbing leak which turned into the need to remove 1/3 of the sheet rock and kitchen/bathroom base cabinets in our condo. We had used AGM last year to remodel our kitchen and were very happy with that outcome so we reached out again to AGM. In a post-hurricane Ian construction atmosphere with availability to contractors being limited, AGM was very accommodating regarding the schedule and turned a tough situation into a smooth process. The Owner Armando is a professional man with a big heart who set us up with a great scheduling team to guide us through the process and a talented group of craftsmen including drywall hangers, plasterers, painters, plumbers and finish carpenters. One last thing; we'd like to specifically thank the project managers Eloy and Adrianna for their diligence on the job and patience with us.
Thanks,
Tom and Deb

reviews_raw.author: Bob Sbarra
reviews_raw.text: Bottom Line is AGM does great work at a reasonable price. They are honest, courteous and on time. I first heard of AGM in 2023 from K and C tile which is where we bought floor tile for the entire house in 2014. In 2023 we decided to remodel both our bathrooms and expand the kitchen cabinets and K and C tile were very positive and had worked with them a lot. We interviewed 4 contractors. AGM had a competitive price and was the only one of the 4 that knew how to match the existing cabinets. The others did not recognize the brand that was already there. Armando took one look and knew where they came from. Armando inspires trust. In April 2023 we signed up with him. He was busy and could not start until the end of June. Our job was convenient for him because we do not spend summers in Naples. He would send pictures of the progress with updates on what was happening. We came back in October and it was like a magic wand was waved. All perfectly done. Then in 2024 we decided to change our center island from 2 levels to one and put in new counter tops and backsplashes made of quartz. From start to finish was 3 days and we did not lose use of the kitchen in the evening. Not only that we did not have to empty any drawers!

reviews_raw.author: Daniel Hamernik
reviews_raw.text: We used AGM recently to have them update our condo. This included a total bathroom renovation with a new shower, a new vanity and top for a guest bedroom, new floors in multiple rooms, new interior doors, new baseboard trim and trim on the new doors and much more. We had an urgent need to get this done ASAP. Armondo, the owner, was able to accommodate all of this in a very short timeline. We can say all the people that came in to work on different items were just super nice people, as well as the office people. They all did a great job down to the fine details. They completed the work in the timeframe we asked. We are now going to use AGM for some more work in the near future. I would highly recommend AGM.   Dan and Kim

reviews_raw.author: Linda O'Hare
reviews_raw.text: From our first meeting with AGM's representative, Eloy, we knew that we would choose them to refresh our condo kitchen and baths. From the beginning, all aspects of the job were handled professionally. The new countertops were installed to perfection and as promised. All of the workers were competent in their individual trades. Once work was started it was completed amazingly in 2 days and on-time. We would recommend AGM without question.
